content:
marta: Heads-up — billing alert from customer acme-inc. Large provisional token spike tied to prefetch + TTL snapshot resume. trace=zz-123

sam: Ugh. Which service path? streaming or background-embed?

marta: streaming route, but prefetch sidecar was enabled. Reconnect happened ~12:03 UTC and we show tokens_charged >> tokens_confirmed.

leo: Can you paste the log snippet?

marta: ```
[2025-03-10T12:03:45Z] trace=zz-123 route=eu-west prefetched=true ttl_s=30 snapshot_id=sn-7 reconnect=true tokens_charged=1212 tokens_confirmed=200
[2025-03-10T12:03:46Z] ledger: provisional_issue id=pv-991 source=prefetch snapshot=sn-7
[2025-03-10T12:03:47Z] resume: kv-snapshot applied, session=ses-452
```

carla: Looks like the resume path re-applied a provisional charge tied to the snapshot. We should be deduping provisional_issue by snapshot_id+session.

sam: We thought snapshot_id was unique, but older runs show snapshot_id gets reused when TTL expires and we re-prefetch. If reconnect happens and snapshot is replayed, ledger sees it as a new provisional.

dave: Confirming: the ledger dedupe key today is provisional_id only, not snapshot fingerprint. So reconnect->replay creates new provisional IDs.

leo: Short term mitigation: block provisional re-issuance if snapshot_id seen in the last X minutes for the same session. Add a metric to catch it.

carla: UI ask: console should surface provisional vs confirmed token columns per request so support can triage refunds quickly. Right now graph lumps everything.

marta: Agreed. Customer noticed ~1.0k token delta. They flagged support. Need quick fix and longer-term fix.

sam: Proposed long-term: make ledger idempotent on (session_id, snapshot_id) and introduce explicit charge_reason enum (prefetch_snapshot_resume, toolcall_retry, stream_truncate, etc) in telemetry. That lets console filter and aggregate.

ops-bot: Scheduled runbook check-list created: runbook/ledgers/dedupe-check. Owner: sam. ETA: 24h.

dave: For rollout UX — we'll need a canary for the ledger change since it touches accounting. Plan: canary 5% of traffic, shadow mode that emits dedupe_decision header but doesn't change charges, then flip.

leo: I can add a probe metric: `prefetch_snapshot_dup_count` with tags {route, region, snapshot_id}. Also expose a top-N table on the billing dashboard.

carla: On the console side I’ll add a provisional/confirmed toggle and a small CTA to request provisional-refund which triggers a backend reconciliation job. Low-risk UX.

sam: Action items: 1) sam file ledger dedupe PR (shadow mode) (#PR TBD) 2) leo add probe metric + dashboard card 3) carla console card + refund CTA 4) marta coordinate with support and customer.

marta: tagging @billing-oncall — customer acme-inc. Please hold refunds until we roll the shadow run and verify.

sam: Will do shadow run first. If shadow metrics show >0.5% duplication for that customer, we can fast-track emergency patch.

dave: Also add telemetry field `charge_trace` that links ledger provisional entries to stream traces. Makes debugging much easier.

ops-bot: Reminder: created incident ticket INC-2025-042 with summary "prefetch snapshot resume provisional spike" and linked thread.

marta: thanks all. I’ll drop the customer note once we have shadow results. :thumbsup:
